name: schedule_log
description: Query the execution log of scheduled tasks. Returns paged records of when each task ran, with status (SUCCESS/FAILURE/RUNNING), trigger time, finish time, duration, and error message on failure. Use this when the CEO agent needs to investigate 'did the 3 AM job actually run', 'how many times did it retry', or 'what was the error'. Combine with schedule_list to first get job IDs, then narrow by date/status.

jobId.description: Filter by specific task ID. Omit to see logs across all tasks.

status.description: Filter by execution status. Omit to see all.

startTime.description: ISO 8601 start time, e.g. '2026-06-24T00:00:00'. Filters logs triggered at or after this time.

endTime.description: ISO 8601 end time, e.g. '2026-06-24T23:59:59'. Filters logs triggered at or before this time.
